subject: bridge-risk-2026
kelp_exploit: $292M (Apr 18, LayerZero 1-of-1 DVN + compromised RPC, attributed Lazarus)
honest_sentence: As of 2026-09-11, bridge configuration risk remains severe: the $292M Kelp exploit (Apr 18) demonstrated that 47% of OApps on 1-of-1 DVN configurations have $4.3B exposed to single-point-of-failure attacks; cumulative bridge losses exceed $2.5B and YTD 2026 losses are $750M+; CCIP has emerged as the institutional winner while LayerZero is in post-Kelp migration mode; these figures are sourced from task-context intelligence and were not independently verified via live search at time of writing.
